title.rendered: I found the best free tools to download videos on X (Twitter) in 2026

content.rendered:
I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve found a video on X that I wanted to save, only to realize that downloading it isn’t as straightforward as it should be. There’s no universal download button for every X (formerly Twitter) video. Some posts allow native downloads, some don’t, and a few third-party downloaders can be helpful, while others can become very spammy.

So I tested many popular ways to download videos from X for offline playback, with and without a Premium subscription. Here’s exactly what I’d use and what I’d avoid.

What makes a good X video downloader?

A good X video downloader should do more than simply produce an MP4 file.

When I test one, these are the things I care about:

  • It actually works: X changes its video system from time to time, so reliability matters more than flashy claims.
  • Good video quality: I want the highest practical resolution available, not a blurry re-encoded copy.
  • Audio stays intact: A video without sound is usually useless.
  • Few steps: It should not be too complicated or time-consuming.
  • No watermark: There’s little reason for a downloader to stamp its own branding onto someone else’s video.
  • No X password required: This is a major red flag. A downloader should not need your X login.
  • Reasonable privacy: I’m much more comfortable with tools that don’t ask for unnecessary permissions or personal information.

One more thing: “free” doesn’t always guarantee quality service. Sometimes free downloader websites are loaded with ads, fake download buttons, and pop-ups. Convenience isn’t worth compromising your device or privacy.

Top 5 ways I download videos from X (Twitter)

Not all tools work best across iPhone, Android, Windows, and Mac. So, I have shared different methods for different users.

Method 1: Native download – My first choice if you have X Premium

Best for: X Premium subscribers who want the simplest and most official option.

This is the method I’d try because it’s the simplest, safest, and most straightforward way to save an X video directly from the post. You don’t need a third-party video downloader, browser extension, or separate app.

X currently allows Premium (blue tick) subscribers to download videos from certain posts in original quality, provided the creator hasn’t disabled downloads. The best part is that the saved video appears directly in the iOS Photos app, rather than in the Offline section of the X app.

First, let’s see how to do this on the mobile app:

  1. Open X and find the post containing the video.
  2. Tap the video to open it in the full-screen view.
  3. Tap the three-dot menu in the top-right corner.
  4. You will see a Download video option if the creator has enabled it. Select it and wait for the process to finish.
  5. Find the saved video in your device’s Photos or Camera Gallery.

Bonus: You can also save videos sent to you in direct messages if the sender has enabled it. Simply open the chat, tap and hold the video, and select Download video. However, if the option is missing, the feature has not yet rolled out to you.

If you mostly use the app on your desktop, follow these steps:

  1. Hover your mouse over the video on your X feed.
  2. Click the gear icon in the playback controls and select Download video.
  3. Sometimes the video opens in a new tab instead of automatically starting the download. In that case, click the three-dot icon in the playback controls > Download.

However, note that not all X videos can be downloaded this way. Creators can disable video downloads, the post may contain age-restricted content, or the video might be from a private account. X also states that the videos posted before July 25, 2023, cannot be saved using this feature.

My rating: 10/10 for Premium users when the download button is available.

Method 2: Save X (Twitter) videos on iPhone using iOS Shortcuts

Best for: iPhone and iPad users who regularly download X videos.

As I’m an iPhone user and the native X download isn’t available, this is the method I reach for. The big advantage is that the downloader lives inside Apple’s Shortcuts app. Instead of opening a sketchy website every time, I can share the X post directly to a shortcut and save the video to Photos.

TVDL is currently designed to extract videos from X, Bluesky, and Mastodon, and save them directly to the Photos app. R⤓Download is another long-running iOS Shortcut that supports Twitter/X video downloads.

How I use the TVDL shortcut:

  1. Go to tvdl.app and select Get TVDL Free. Enter your email address and send the download link.
  2. From your iPhone Mail app, open the email, tap Confirm & Download. You will be redirected to the Shortcuts app. Tap Add Shortcut to complete the setup.
  3. Find the X post containing the video.
  4. Tap the Share button under the post and select Share via to open the iOS Share Sheet.
  5. Scroll down and select TVDL 4.1.0 from there.
  6. Allow the permissions for the first time.
  7. Choose the available video quality, if prompted.
  8. Let the shortcut process the video.
  9. Open Photos, and the video should be in your Camera Roll.

TVDL is a good option because it lets you select the video quality and provides shortcut updates that help with smooth operations. Shortcuts’ reliability can vary depending on changes to X and the shortcut’s underlying extraction method.

Overall, this method is my favorite free option for iPhone. I don’t have to keep an X video downloader website bookmarked or install a separate downloader app. The only downside is obvious: this is an Apple-centric solution. It isn’t the answer for Android users.

My rating: 9.5/10 on iPhone.

Method 3: Use trusted third-party X/Twitter video downloader apps

Best for: people who prefer using an app rather than a browser or Shortcut.

A dedicated app can make sense if you regularly save videos and want a more repeatable workflow.

For iPhone, you can try apps like TweetSave to save Tweet/X videos, photos, and GIFs to your Photos. Its basic workflow is simple: copy the post URL, paste it into the app, and process the content.

For Android users, apps such as TwiTake work similarly to iOS Shortcuts. No need to copy-paste links. Tap the share button under the video post, select Share via, and choose TwiTake from the options.

Here’s how I use the TweetSave app:

  1. Open X and find the video.
  2. Tap the Share button and select Copy Link.
  3. Open the downloader app.
  4. Paste the X video URL and tap Find.
  5. Check if the right video is fetched. Tap Save to download it.
  6. Once done, tap OK and check the resulting media in your Photos app.

The biggest advantage is convenience if you download X videos frequently. However, I wouldn’t install an unknown downloader. Check the developer, reviews, permissions, and update history first.

However, if an app asks for your X password just to download a public video, that’s my cue to leave.

My rating: 7.5/10, but only when the app has a trustworthy developer and sensible permissions.

Method 4: Online tools to download X/Twitter videos on Mac or PC

Best for: one-off downloads when you don’t want to install anything.

This is the classic method for browser-based downloads on mobile and desktop.

For example, SSSTwitter currently supports public X posts and offers SD/HD options. But it shows ads for higher-quality downloads.

The one I personally like best is X Downloader. It allows downloading multiple videos, broadcasts, and GIFs from posts and comments together in full HD and 4K without watermarks.

You can even extract the video’s soundtrack as an MP3. To safeguard your privacy, the tool doesn’t redirect to sketchy websites and streams the file directly to your device from X’s content delivery network.

  1. Open X and copy the link to the video you want to download.
  2. Open the downloader website in your preferred browser.
  3. Paste the X post URL and tap Download Video.
  4. Select the available video quality.
  5. Rename the file if you want and save the MP4.

If you are using this on your iPhone or Android, the saved video goes to the Files app rather than the Photos app.

For a single video, it’s hard to beat. There’s no installation and no setup. It works in a browser, which makes it useful on Android, iPhone, Windows, and Mac.

However, don’t enter your account, payment details, or sensitive information. Watch for misleading buttons, pop-ups, redirects, and requests to install unrelated software.

My rating: 8/10 for occasional downloads; 5/10 if you use downloader sites every day.

Method 5: Chrome extensions for one-click downloads

Best for: desktop users who download X videos very often.

When you are saving several videos from X, constantly copying and pasting links becomes a nuisance. A Chrome extension can put the download function closer to the video itself.

The idea is simple:

  1. Install a reputable X video downloader extension, such as Twitter Downloader.
  2. Open X in Chrome.
  3. Find the video.
  4. You will see a Download button next to the share icon. Tap it and save the file.

Once configured, it can be considerably faster than opening a separate website for every video.

But extensions get one big warning from me: browser extensions have permissions. Before installing one, check the publisher, what permissions it requests, whether it’s actively maintained, and whether reviews look legitimate. Also, downloading videos very frequently can lead to your account being blocked. So, be cautious!

My rating: 8/10 for heavy desktop users.

Which method should you choose?

If you just want the short version, here’s how I’d rank the five methods:

If I had to recommend one free method to the average iPhone user, I’d pick a reputable iOS Shortcut such as TVDL.

If I had X Premium and the post offered a “Download video” option, I’d skip everything else and use X’s own button.

Common problems and how to fix them

1. There is no Download video option

This usually means the post isn’t eligible for X’s native download feature, the creator has disabled downloads, or you’re not using an account with the required Premium access.

Try an appropriate third-party method for a public post, such as an iOS Shortcut or an online downloader.

2. The downloader says no video found

First, make sure you copied the post URL, not the account/profile URL. Ensure the link is complete, not broken. If that’s correct, the video might have been made private or deleted.

Try another tool or wait a bit and retry.

3. Downloaded video has no sound

Try another available quality or download option. Some third-party services can fail to combine video and audio correctly.

If one downloader gives you a silent file, I don’t waste much time fighting it—I try a different reputable method.

4. Video quality is terrible

Don’t select the smallest file without thinking twice.

If there are multiple resolutions available, choose the highest one. A 480p file may download quickly, but it won’t magically offer the original clarity.

5. The video won’t download from a private account

That’s expected for many third-party services. Tools such as SSSTwitter explicitly state that they support public posts rather than private-account videos.

Don’t look for a supposed “private video bypass.” That’s exactly the sort of rabbit hole I avoid.

6. The iOS Shortcut stopped working

This is one of the biggest realities of social-media downloaders: they can break when the platform rules change. TVDL itself warns of such potential impact and suggests updating the shortcut as well.

If it doesn’t work, temporarily switch to another legitimate method.

Safety and privacy tips

This is the part I wouldn’t skip just because you’re in a hurry to save a funny video.

  • Never give a downloader your X password: A public video URL shouldn’t require your X credentials. If a website says “Log in with X to download,” I would close it.
  • Watch for fake download buttons: Some downloader websites surround the actual download link with advertisements that look like buttons. If clicking “Download” suddenly opens another website, don’t blindly continue.
  • Avoid random APK files: Android gives you plenty of flexibility, but that’s not a reason to sideload an unknown downloader from a random website. Use reputable app stores and verify the developer.
  • Review browser extension permissions: An extension that downloads videos shouldn’t need wildly excessive access to your browsing activity. If the permissions don’t make sense, don’t install it.
  • Don’t upload sensitive videos to random services: Public X videos are one thing. Private, personal, or confidential material is another. I would never upload sensitive media to an unknown downloader just to save a few seconds.
  • Respect the creator’s copyright: Saving a video to your phone doesn’t make it yours. If you plan to repost, edit, monetize, or use someone else’s video commercially, check the creator’s rights and applicable copyright rules first.

Final thoughts

After trying the major ways to download videos from X, I’ve come to a pretty simple conclusion: There isn’t one universal “best X video downloader.” There is a best method for your situation.

For X Premium members, I would use X’s built-in “Download video” option every time it appears. It’s the cleanest and most trustworthy route. As for iPhone owners, I would prefer an iOS Shortcut like TVDL. It transforms the unpleasant process into two clicks and saves the video directly to Photos.

For saving multiple videos together, an online X video downloader is convenient because there’s nothing to install. And for desktop power users, a reputable Chrome extension can make repeated downloads much faster.

The main takeaway? Do not pick a downloader on the promise of “the fastest 4K downloads.” Select the one that is functional, doesn’t ask for your X password, protects your privacy, and doesn’t make you struggle with ten fake download buttons.

Is it legal to download videos from X (Formerly Twitter)?

Yes, you can download videos for watching later or for other personal use. But reposting, especially for commercial use, may violate copyright laws. Always credit the original creator and seek permission before reuploading.

How to download a private Twitter video?

For a private or protected X account, the only way is to screen record the video. Most third-party X video downloaders support only public posts. I wouldn’t recommend trying to bypass the account’s privacy controls.

keyPoints.title: Downloading Twitter Videos Is Usually Legal for Personal Use
keyPoints.explanation: You can save videos from Twitter for personal viewing, but reposting or commercial use may violate copyright laws; always credit creators and seek permission.

keyPoints.title: Methods for Downloading Twitter Videos Vary by Device and Subscription
keyPoints.explanation: Depending on whether you're on iPhone, Android, or desktop, and whether you have a premium account, there are different safe methods like native downloads, apps, online tools, or browser extensions.

keyPoints.title: iPhone Users Can Save Videos Using Native Options or Shortcuts
keyPoints.explanation: Premium iPhone users can download videos directly within the app, while others can use iOS shortcuts like TVDL or R Download, which save videos to Photos without third-party apps.

keyPoints.title: Android Users Have More Flexibility with Apps and Browsers
keyPoints.explanation: Android users can use third-party apps like TwiTake or online downloaders, benefiting from greater freedom to choose quality and storage options without restrictions.

keyPoints.title: Browser Tools and Extensions Make Desktop Downloads Easier
keyPoints.explanation: On desktop, tools like SSSTwitter, Twittervid, or Chrome extensions allow quick, single-click downloads directly from the browser, streamlining the process for PC or Mac users.

title.rendered: macOS 26.7 code references a Home hub, iPhone Ultra, camera AirPods, and a dozen other unreleased Apple products

content.rendered:
Apple seeded the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate on Monday, and while the update itself is a security fix with no new features, its code is packed with hardware Apple has not announced. MacRumors dug through the build and found identifiers for a home hub, a new HomePod mini, camera-equipped AirPods, AirPods Pro 4, all five upcoming iPhones including the foldable, an M6 MacBook Pro, new iMacs, an OLED iPad mini, and more.

Some of these codenames were in earlier builds and now carry new feature flags; others are new. Code references are not launch confirmations, but the list lines up with what Apple is expected to ship over the next several months.

Home devices are the biggest group

The smart home side has the most entries. The code includes Siri setup references for J490, the base version of Apple’s home hub, and J491, the wall-mounted version. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has said the hub is due between October and early 2027, with a September preview possible.

There is also a device called B525 with a software component named “Argentium” installed. The current HomePod mini is B520, so B525 likely points to the second-generation HomePod mini that Gurman has tipped for the fall. A third entry, J229, is a home accessory with multiple sensors that first showed up in iOS 26 code last December. It could be a security camera or an add-on for the hub.

The home section also mentions “Pebble,” Bloomberg’s reported codename for homeOS, two unexplained HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3 devices, color strings for Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight, and an “audio accessory visual reasoning” feature that may belong to the hub.

All five 2026-27 iPhones are listed

The iPhone identifiers are V62 (iPhone Air 2), V63 (iPhone 18 Pro), V64 (iPhone 18 Pro Max), V67 (iPhone 18), and V68, the foldable that Apple reportedly calls iPhone Ultra internally. These are the same identifiers that surfaced in iOS 27 beta code earlier this month. The Pro models and the foldable are expected in September, with the iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 following in spring 2027.

AirPods, Beats, and a fourth-gen AirPods Pro

The headphone references are the most concrete. One string reads “B790 start image stream failed for left bud.” B790 is the codename Bloomberg has tied to Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods, and MacRumors says it is a separate project from B798, the camera AirPods Bloomberg has slotted for 2027. Gurman has said B790 could ship as soon as September, though the AirPods were not on his most recent list of products for the event.

The build also mentions AirPodsPro1,4. AirPods Pro 3 is AirPodsPro1,3, so this looks like a fourth-generation AirPods Pro. Two Beats identifiers, B518 and B522, likely point to upcoming Beats headphones.

Macs and an OLED iPad mini

On the Mac side, J804 appears to be the entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M6 chip, since the current M5 model is J704. J833 and J834 match the next-generation iMacs Bloomberg has reported. Four more identifiers, K114c, K114s, K116c, and K116s, may be the higher-end OLED MacBook Pro models Apple is expected to introduce with M6 Pro and M6 Max chips.

The iPad entries are J510 and J511, which line up with the next iPad mini. That model is rumored to move to an OLED display and an A19 Pro chip.

The rest of the list

N109 is a headset that Bloomberg once identified as Vision Pro 2 and The Information described as a cheaper Vision Pro. It was reportedly canceled in 2025, so this may be leftover code. ATVRemote1,5 points to a new Siri Remote. There are also references to Apple Intelligence Writing Tools expanding to China with content restrictions, plus a batch of A-series model numbers MacRumors could not match to products.

When any of this could ship

Gurman’s latest Power On newsletter listed eight products for the September event: the two iPhone 18 Pro models, the iPhone Ultra, Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, a new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and a first look at the home hub. He expects the M6 MacBook Pro and iPad mini in October, which fits MacRumors’ read that Apple may hold a second event in October or November for the Macs, iPad mini, and home accessories.

The code does not give dates. With the September event a few weeks away and macOS 27 due right after it, this is likely the last Tahoe update where the fall lineup shows up in code before it shows up on stage.

title.rendered: iOS 27 beta 6 arrives with a Messages fix and a new notification animation

content.rendered:
Apple released iOS 27 developer beta 6 on Monday, one week after beta 5. The build is 24A5418b, and it landed alongside beta 6 of iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, and visionOS 27. A few hours later, the same builds reached public beta testers as iOS 27 public beta 4.

Don’t expect much that you can see. Apple has moved to weekly betas this month, and beta 6 is about stability and small cleanups before the September launch, not new features.

What changed in beta 6

The most useful fix is in Messages. The Pinned Messages bug from beta 5, where the pinned list did not display properly, appears to be resolved in beta 6, according to 9to5Mac. Notifications also get a new animation: the banner now morphs into the Notification Center indicator instead of simply fading out.

Beyond that, the changes are cosmetic. MacRumors found a Shortcuts splash screen and an updated Game Center icon, continuing the icon refresh that started with the Safari, Siri, and Settings icons in beta 5.

macOS 27 got the more visible tweaks in this round:

  • Redesigned stoplight window controls, which now show an HDR highlight when clicked.
  • A Preview app icon that matches the iOS version introduced last week.
  • Two new dynamic wallpapers, Golden Gate Day and Golden Gate Evening, joining the existing Sunset and Night versions.

Apple’s developer release notes still carry the long list of Siri, CarPlay, dictation, and Core AI fixes that built up over earlier betas, but they do not call out anything specific to beta 6.

How to install it

If you are already on the iOS 27 developer beta, the update shows up under Settings > General > Software Update. New testers need a developer account, free or paid, and Beta Updates switched on from that screen; the iOS 27 developer beta install guide walks through it. Public beta users can grab public beta 4 from the same Software Update screen after enrolling at beta.apple.com.

iOS 27 runs on the iPhone 11 and later, plus the iPhone SE 2 and newer. Siri AI and the wider Apple Intelligence features still need recent hardware.

Where the release cycle stands

Beta 6 arrives a little over two months after WWDC, and the pace shows how close Apple is to done. Betas 1 through 4 came every two weeks, beta 5 took three, and beta 6 followed just a week later as a smaller download with fewer visible changes.

Apple typically seeds one or two more betas and then a release candidate, and the final version is expected in September alongside the new iPhones. That leaves a few weeks for Apple to settle the last rough edges of Siri AI and the rest of iOS 27 before it reaches every supported iPhone.

Apple also shipped iOS 26.6.1 on the same day for anyone staying on the current release.

title.rendered: Apple’s own demo video shows AirPods with cameras using Visual Intelligence

content.rendered:
Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods have shown up in the company’s own software. MacRumors found a demo video inside the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate that Apple seeded on Monday, and it shows the earbuds using Visual Intelligence to read the cover of a book. MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris posted the clip on X.

Apple has not announced the product. But a finished, voiced-over tutorial sitting in a release candidate is a much stronger signal than a code string, and it fits Bloomberg’s report that these AirPods could launch as soon as September.

What the video shows

The clip is short. A person wearing AirPods holds up a book so the earbuds’ camera can see the title, and Siri’s voice explains the pitch: “With Visual Intelligence, your world becomes savable. See something you like? Just ask me to save it for later.”

That matches how the feature has been described in reports so far. The cameras give Siri a live view of what is in front of you, so you can ask about an object, a landmark, or some text and have Siri answer or save it, without pulling out your iPhone and pointing its camera. Apple has also built in a warning for when the earbuds are blocked, by hair for example: “To get the most accurate information about things in your environment, make sure AirPods are not covered.”

The earbuds in the video look close to the current AirPods Pro, and the cameras themselves are not obvious in the clip.

The code points to the same product

The macOS 26.7 RC also references the earbuds by their codename, B790, including a string about starting an “image stream” from the left bud. That is the same codename that turned up in iOS 27 beta code in July, where it handled two images from cameras on either side of the wearer’s head.

Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reported earlier this month that Apple has two camera AirPods projects. B790 is the further-along one and is listed internally as a candidate to ship this year. A more advanced model, B798, has slipped to 2027. Bloomberg had said back in May that the camera AirPods were in advanced testing, so the timeline has been tightening for a while.

What to expect at the September event

Gurman expects the earbuds to arrive as soon as September, which would put them at the same event as the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the foldable iPhone Ultra. Apple has not sent invitations yet, but the event usually lands in the second week of September.

According to his reporting, the buds use tiny infrared cameras in both earpieces, with a small LED that lights up when they are active. The cameras are not meant for photos or video; they exist to feed Visual Intelligence. Because of that, and because they should cost more than the $249 AirPods Pro 3, Gurman has said Apple is likely to call them AirPods Ultra rather than AirPods Pro 4.

The privacy questions are obvious. An LED indicator helps, but earbuds that can quietly look at a room are a harder sell in public than a phone camera you have to visibly point. Apple’s answer to that will matter as much as the feature itself when it finally puts these on stage.

title.rendered: Google Pixel Watch 5 vs. Apple Watch Series 11: Which should you buy?

content.rendered:
The Google Pixel Watch 5 and Apple Watch Series 11 now start at the same $399 price, but they are made for completely different phones. Pixel Watch 5 is the better pick for Android users who want longer battery life, dual-frequency GPS, and Google’s newest health tools. Apple Watch Series 11 remains the easier choice for iPhone owners because of its tighter app, messaging, and Mac integration.

If you are choosing between them without considering your phone, start there. You cannot use Apple Watch Series 11 with Android, and Pixel Watch 5 is not an iPhone alternative.

Google Pixel Watch 5 vs. Apple Watch Series 11: Quick comparison

The table below uses the base GPS/Wi-Fi models and the larger versions where the sizes are comparable. LTE versions cost more on both sides.

Your phone decides the winner first

The Pixel Watch 5 works with Android phones and requires a Google Account plus the Google Pixel Watch app. Google recommends checking the exact phone model before buying because compatibility and individual features vary by device and country.

The Apple Watch Series 11 requires an iPhone 11 or newer running iOS 26 or later. It does not pair with Android phones, even if you only want basic notifications and fitness tracking.

That makes the first decision simple: Android users should buy the Pixel Watch 5, while iPhone users should buy the Apple Watch Series 11. Switching ecosystems just to use the other watch rarely makes financial sense.

Pixel Watch 5 wins on battery and GPS

Pixel Watch 5 has the more useful hardware advantages for everyday wear. Google rates the 41mm model for up to 30 hours and the 45mm model for up to 40 hours, compared with 24 hours for Apple Watch Series 11. Those are still estimates, but the difference gives the Pixel Watch more room for overnight sleep tracking, workouts, and LTE use before you reach for the charger.

The 45mm Pixel Watch 5 is also the better choice for runners and cyclists on paper. Its dual-frequency GPS can use L1 and L5 signals, while the Series 11 uses single-band L1 GPS. The difference will not matter on every walk, but it can help when tall buildings, trees, or crowded streets make route tracking harder.

Google also gives the Pixel Watch 5 a brighter display, rated up to 3,000 nits. The circular design is less practical for some text and apps than Apple’s wider rectangular screen, but the larger 45mm model is easy to read outdoors.

Apple Watch Series 11 feels more polished on iPhone

Apple’s advantage is not a single specification. It is how many small things work together when you already use an iPhone, AirPods, Mac, or Apple Pay.

Messages, calls, music controls, Siri, workouts, notifications, and third-party watch apps all feel like parts of the same system. The Series 11 also has a wider rectangular display that is better for reading longer notifications and navigating apps. Its Ion-X glass on aluminum models is twice as scratch-resistant as the previous generation, while titanium models use sapphire crystal.

The Series 11 is also thinner than the Pixel Watch 5. That matters if you sleep in your watch or prefer something that sits flat under a shirt cuff. It is not as bright as Google’s watch, but 2,000 nits is still enough for normal outdoor use.

If you want to compare Apple’s current lineup before choosing, this Apple Watch buying guide puts the Series 11 between the cheaper SE 3 and the tougher Ultra 3.

If you are wondering how much an Apple Watch can do when your iPhone is not nearby, this guide to what Apple Watch can do without an iPhone covers the useful standalone features.

Pixel Watch 5 has the more ambitious health upgrades

Both watches cover the basics well: heart rate, sleep stages, workouts, fall detection, irregular-rhythm alerts, and safety features. The difference is in what each company is trying to add next.

Pixel Watch 5 introduces Google’s Health Guardian suite, including monthly blood-pressure trends, insulin-resistance trends, Sleep Breathing Quality, improved sleep-stage tracking, and Breathing Emergency Detection in selected markets. It also adds a Google Health Coach powered by Gemini for workout and recovery suggestions.

Those features make the Pixel Watch 5 more interesting for people who want background health trends rather than only workout numbers. But treat them as wellness insights, not medical diagnoses. Availability varies by region, some features may require a Google Health or Fitbit Premium subscription, and Google’s newest tools still need time to prove how useful they are in daily life.

Apple Watch Series 11 takes a more established approach. It adds sleep score and hypertension notifications while retaining ECG, blood oxygen tracking, temperature sensing, sleep apnea notifications, and a wide range of workout tools. Some health features are unavailable in certain countries, so check Apple’s regional availability before buying.

If you want the newest health experiments, Pixel Watch 5 is the more interesting option. If you want a mature health platform with a broader track record and strong iPhone integration, Apple Watch Series 11 is the safer pick.

Apple charges faster, but Pixel needs fewer charging breaks

Apple Watch Series 11 can reach 80% in about 30 minutes, and a five-minute charge can provide up to eight hours of sleep tracking. That makes it easy to top up while showering or getting ready.

Pixel Watch 5 also supports fast charging and can provide a full day of use from a short charge, depending on the model and settings. Its main advantage is that you will need to do those quick charging breaks less often, especially with the 45mm version.

Neither watch is a multi-day fitness watch. If you want to wear a watch for a week without thinking about charging, look beyond both of these models.

Android users who want a different design or longer battery life should also check these best Apple Watch alternatives before buying.

Which one should you buy?

Buy the Google Pixel Watch 5 if you:

  • Use an Android phone, especially a Pixel.
  • Want longer battery life in a normal smartwatch.
  • Run, cycle, or hike often and want dual-frequency GPS.
  • Prefer Google Maps, Google Wallet, Gemini, and Fitbit-style health insights.
  • Are willing to wait for some new health features to become available in your region.

Buy the Apple Watch Series 11 if you:

  • Use an iPhone and want the smoothest overall experience.
  • Care more about apps, messaging, Apple Pay, and iPhone integration than battery life.
  • Prefer a thinner watch with a wider rectangular display.
  • Want established health features such as ECG, sleep score, and hypertension notifications.
  • Already use a Mac, AirPods, Apple Fitness+, or other Apple services.

The verdict

The Pixel Watch 5 is the better smartwatch hardware value: it lasts longer, gets brighter, and offers more ambitious GPS and health features at the same starting price. Apple Watch Series 11 is the better everyday companion for iPhone owners because its software and ecosystem are still harder to beat.

So the practical answer is straightforward: choose Pixel Watch 5 for Android, Apple Watch Series 11 for iPhone. Only compare the finer details after that first decision.

title.rendered: 7 best Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 cases I’d actually buy

content.rendered:
After spending time with the new Galaxy Z Flip 8, one thing became clear to me: its appeal is in how compact and refined it feels when folded. Compared with the Flip 7, Samsung has made the Flip 8 feel more polished, lightweight, and thinner without losing that pocket-friendly character. The problem is that a bulky case can quickly ruin that experience.

That’s why I was picky about the case I put on it. It should provide enough protection against everyday drops and scratches, but not so much that the phone feels awkward to fold or too thick in my pocket. After trying and comparing different styles, these are the Galaxy Z Flip 8 cases I’d actually consider using day-to-day.

How I choose the best Galaxy Z Flip 8 cases

The best Galaxy Z Flip 8 case isn’t necessarily the toughest one. It’s the case that gets the protection-to-usability ratio right.

Here are the things I care about most.

  • Protection comes first: The Galaxy Z Flip 8 is expensive, so protection obviously matters. I look for solid corner protection, raised edges, scratch resistance, and sensible hinge coverage without unnecessary bulk.
  • Slimness really matters: The Flip 8 is designed to be compact when folded. If a case feels thick and awkward in my pocket, it loses points.
  • Grip over looks: A case can look great in photos, but if it feels slippery in my hand, I wouldn’t recommend it for everyday use.
  • Perfect fit is non-negotiable: The two case pieces should stay firmly attached and aligned when I open and close the phone. Any movement or loose edges are a red flag.
  • Everyday features should work: I check button response, wireless charging, magnetic accessory compatibility, and access to the cover screen.
  • The price has to make sense: I’m happy to pay more for better materials or useful features, but a cheaper case can be the smarter buy if it provides reliable protection.

Overall, the best Galaxy Z Flip 8 case is the one that protects the phone without making me forget why I bought a foldable in the first place.

Top Galaxy Z Flip 8 cases I’d recommend

Here, I’ve shared 7 different cases you can buy for everyday use based on your requirements.

1. Samsung Official Silicone Ring Case with Magnet: Best overall

Samsung’s official silicone case is the easy recommendation because it’s specifically designed for the Flip 8. I love the silicone finish of this case because it makes my phone comfortable to hold without being bulky.

The built-in ring is surprisingly useful. You can put your finger into it when scrolling, taking pictures, or holding the phone. It gives me extra confidence that the Flip 8 won’t slip. The built-in magnetics are a practical touch if you already use wireless charging and magnetic accessories.

I also like that the semi-transparent case keeps the Flip 8’s stylish look rather than hiding it under a bulky protective shell. Choose the one that matches your phone’s color for a seamless look.

Pros

  • Soft, comfortable, and easy to grip
  • Ring makes one-handed use more secure
  • Convenient for magnetic accessories
  • Keeps the Flip8 looking slim and stylish
  • Good choice for everyday use

Cons

  • Adds a little bulk compared with going caseless
  • Ring takes some getting used to
  • Protection may not satisfy heavy-duty users

Best for: Anyone who wants a stylish, comfortable everyday case with better grip and magnetic convenience, especially if you regularly use your Flip8 one-handed.

Check out on Amazon

2. Spigen Ultra Hybrid Pro MagFit: Best clear Galaxy Z Flip 8 case

If you bought the Flip 8 partly because you love how it looks, I’ll recommend the Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit. The appeal here is straightforward: you get to see the phone while still giving it a protective outer shell. Unlike other clear cases, its anti-yellowing treatment helps maintain that clarity over time.

For everyday protection, Air Cushion technology helps absorb impacts, while raised camera bezels keep the lenses away from flat surfaces. What I particularly like is how much attention Spigen has given to the hinge and magnetic connection. Its patented spring-hinge mechanism automatically encloses the hinge, so it stays protected whether the phone is open or folded.

The built-in N55SH magnets provide a strong, heat-resistant connection to the compatible MagSafe accessories. I have also tested it with Qi2.2 chargers, and it fully supports faster, more consistent wireless charging. If you want to stand out more, choose the Neo One design.

Pros

  • Strong N55SH magnetic grip for charging and accessories
  • Fully enclosed, spring-loaded hinge protection
  • Clear, anti-yellowing protection from UV and stains
  • Close-fitting for zero bulkiness

Cons

  • More substantial than ultra-thin cases
  • The clear finish can still show fingerprints and dust
  • Premium price compared with basic clear cases

Best for: Flip 8 owners who want maximum everyday protection, strong magnetic accessory support, hinge coverage, and a clear case that still lets the phone’s design shine.

Check out on Amazon

3. PITAKA Caseless-Feel Aramid Fiber Case: Best for minimalists

I love the original feel of Flip 8, but I’m not quite brave enough to carry an expensive foldable completely naked. That’s where PITAKA’s ultra-thin approach makes sense. The first thing I noticed is how thin and light it is. At around 0.04 in thick and 0.6oz light, it preserves much of the phone’s original slim, natural feel.

The real style highlight is the finely woven aramid fiber, which gives it a subtle, premium, silky-smooth texture. I got a good grip without fighting fingerprint smudges. The aerospace-grade woven aramid construction also adds scratch and everyday-wear resistance without turning the Flip 8 bulky.

I’d especially recommend it if you use magnetic accessories. The Flip 8 case supports fast wireless charging, while the stronger internal anti-slip strips help keep the minimalist two-piece design securely in place. But I wouldn’t prefer it for somebody who regularly drops their phone. There’s no hinge protection here.

Pros

  • Extremely slim and lightweight, almost caseless in hand
  • Silky, refined texture with excellent tactile feel
  • Minimalist design looks sophisticated
  • Raised camera frame for added lens protection

Cons

  • Minimal coverage means it isn’t the choice for serious drop protection
  • No hinge protection
  • Premium price for a minimalist case

Best for: Anyone who bought the Z Flip 8 for its slim, elegant design and wants protection without sacrificing that original phone-in-hand feeling.

Check out on Amazon

4. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Galaxy Z Flip 8 Case: For rugged protection

Looking for an ultimate protective rugged case? SUPCASE UB Pro is the best choice. Instead of focusing on keeping the phone slim and barely noticeable, it goes all-in on protection and convenience.

The first thing I’d notice in everyday use is the 360° rotating belt clip. It’s especially practical when you’re working outdoors, traveling, hiking, commuting, or simply don’t want to keep a foldable phone loose in your pocket. The built-in kickstand is genuinely useful for watching videos, taking hands-free calls, or setting the Flip 8 down while working.

Protection is clearly the priority. The rugged full-body construction, hinge coverage, anti-slip grip, and front screen protection give the phone a much more armored feel. The kickstand-style functionality also makes this more versatile than a basic protective shell.

Pros

  • Excellent all-around protection for people
  • 360° rotating belt clip makes carrying the Flip 8 convenient
  • Built-in kickstand is useful for videos, calls, reading, and hands-free viewing.
  • Anti-slip design gives the phone a more secure grip

Cons

  • Heavyweight compared with slim Z Flip 8 cases
  • The belt clip adds extra bulk
  • Only compatible with Samsung wireless charging pad

Best for: Anyone who would rather have maximum protection than a slim case.

Check out on Amazon

5. FNTCASE magnetic matte case: Best in budget

You don’t necessarily need to spend premium-case money to protect a premium phone. That’s the appeal of FNTCASE. It has a TPU/PC construction, with 10 ft of military-grade protection around the hinge, screen, cameras, and edges. You also get a screen protector that adds another layer between the outer display and scratches or impacts.

In everyday use, the matte finish gives the phone a grippier, less slippery feel and doesn’t constantly attract fingerprints. I also like that the translucent back lets the Flip 8’s original design show through. It has built-in N52 magnets for Qi charging and accessories.

Of course, the cheaper option has to make compromises somewhere. I wouldn’t expect the same level of refinement as Samsung’s official case or a premium option like PITAKA. But if your main goal is simply “protect my Flip 8 without spending a fortune”, it’s the best option.

Pros

  • Excellent combination of protection and everyday usability
  • Built-in screen protector gives additional protector
  • Nano antioxidant layer resists smudges, stains, sweat, and scratches
  • 0.33 in sleek and minimal form factor

Cons

  • Hinge mechanisms can potentially collect dust or debris
  • MagSafe compatibility is not considered

Best for: Good choice for someone who wants rugged protection without a belt clip or oversized kickstand.

Check out on Amazon

6. TORRO leather case for Galaxy Z Flip 8: Premium option for professionals

If your idea of a premium accessory involves leather, the TORRO case takes the Flip 8 in a different direction. What I like about its top-grain cowhide leather is that the case can make a phone feel more personal over time. Silicone stays silicone, plastic stays plastic, leather can develop its own character with use.

I like the two-part frame because it fits the Z Flip 8’s folding form snugly. The phone is held securely, while the outer leather cover provides additional coverage over the hinge when the phone is closed. In addition, the magnet clasp will ensure that everything is well-secured.

But I wouldn’t buy this expecting military-grade drop protection. TORRO’s design is much more about protecting against everyday knocks, scratches, and wear while maintaining a premium leather aesthetic. Besides, leather can show signs of wear-and-tear.

Pros

  • Leather can develop a patina over time, making the case feel more personal
  • Microfibre lining helps protect the phone’s back from scratches and marks
  • Looks more professional and sophisticated than most rugged plastic cases

Cons

  • Not the best choice for extreme drop protection.
  • The magnetic clasp can feel less convenient than a simple open-back case
  • No built-in kickstand, belt clip, or MagSafe-style accessory system
  • Leather requires a little more care to maintain its original appearance

Best for: Professionals and business users who want their phone case to look polished.

Check out on Amazon

7. Dexnor Heavy-Duty Bumper Case: Best Galaxy Z Flip 8 Case with kickstand

Finally, when I want my Galaxy Z Flip 8 protected for active, everyday use, the Dexnor case would be one of the more practical rugged options. It takes the protective approach seriously, combining full-body coverage, auto-close hinge protection, and a built-in screen protector in one package.

What I like most about it is the functionality it offers. The dual kickstand feature lets you use the phone hands-free for watching videos, making calls, following recipes, or any other activity where you want your phone propped up on your desk.

Pros

  • Heavy-duty full-body protection for people who are rough on their phones.
  • Kickstands can be useful in both portrait and landscape orientations.
  • Great feature set if you want protection and functionality in one case.

Cons

  • Bulky and heavier than slim Z Flip8 cases.
  • Built-in screen protectors may not feel as smooth as using the phone’s display
  • Not the best choice if your priority is minimal thickness, pocketability, or showing off the original Flip8 design.

Best for: Outdoor work, travel, commuting, and active lifestyles.

Check out on Amazon

Galaxy Z Flip 8 cases you should avoid

Not every Galaxy Z Flip 8 case deserves your money. In fact, I’d rather tell you what not to buy than pad this list with ten nearly identical cases.

  • Cases that are too bulky: The whole reason to buy a Flip phone is its compact form factor. So if your case turns that into a small brick, I’m out. Rugged cases have their place. But unless you genuinely need that level of protection, don’t buy the bulk.
  • Poorly fitted two-piece cases: This is one area where I’d be especially picky with a foldable. If a case shifts, rattles, lifts at the edges, or feels loose after installation, that’s a deal-breaker for me.
  • Cases with questionable hinge coverage: The hinge is one of the sensitive parts of a foldable, so I pay attention to how a case treats it. If it adds enormous bulk while offering little practical benefit, I’d rather have a better-balanced case.
  • Cases that interfere with charging or accessories: A case shouldn’t make ordinary phone habits annoying. Before buying, check compatibility with the accessories you already use, especially wireless chargers, magnetic mounts, and wallets.

What to consider when choosing the Flip 8 case

Not all cases are the same. So you need to evaluate your necessities to choose the right one for your lifestyle.

What level of protection do you need?

Be honest about your lifestyle.

If your Flip 8 mostly travels between your desk, car, and home, you probably don’t need the heaviest case available. However, if you’re outdoors every day, travel constantly, or have a history of dropping phones, I’d happily accept more bulk for better protection.

Do you want slim, rugged, or somewhere in between?

I’d break the market into three broad groups.

  • Slim: PITAKA and similar cases for preserving the original Flip 8 experience.
  • Every day: Samsung and Spigen offer the best balance of protection, usability, and design.
  • Rugged: SUPCASE and Dexnor. Best for people who prioritize protection or extra functionality.

There is no universal winner here. There is only the best fit for your habits.

Is hinge protection worth prioritizing?

Yes, but don’t let the phrase become a marketing shortcut. I’d rather have a case with sensible overall coverage and excellent fit than a giant hinge mechanism that makes the phone twice as bulky.

Think about how you actually carry the phone. If it’s usually in a pocket or bag, protection from scratches and impacts matters differently than it does for someone working outdoors.

Do you need magnetic accessories?

If you already use magnetic power banks, mounts, wallets, or chargers, this should be part of your buying decision, not an afterthought.

The Samsung and Spigen options are particularly interesting if magnetic accessory compatibility is important to you.

Just remember that magnetic compatibility isn’t a reason to buy a bad case. Fit, protection, and usability should come first.

Is a kickstand worth the extra bulk?

For some people, absolutely. For everyone? Definitely not.

If you watch videos, make video calls, travel frequently, or use your phone on a desk, a kickstand can be one of those features you suddenly wonder how you lived without.

If you mostly text, scroll, and take photos, it’ll probably spend most of its life folded into the case doing nothing.

My final pick: Which Galaxy Z Flip 8 case should you buy?

After looking at these seven cases, I’d make the decision very simple.

The right case depends on whether you value slimness, protection, style, or everyday convenience. The Galaxy Z Flip 8 itself is exceptionally thin and light, so I’d avoid adding unnecessary bulk unless you really need rugged protection.

Which case did you like the most? Let me know in the comments below!

title.rendered: Google releases Gemini 3.7 Flash with big coding gains and a half-price launch offer

content.rendered:
Google has released Gemini 3.7 Flash, a new version of its workhorse AI model built for coding and agent tasks, just three weeks after Gemini 3.6 Flash. It is available now, and Google is charging half the usual rate for it through the end of 2026.

This is not a new model built from scratch. Google describes 3.7 Flash as a refinement of 3.6 Flash, with algorithmic improvements to its reasoning rather than a fresh training run. The short gap between releases is the point: Google says developer feedback and those quicker improvements are driving a faster release rhythm for the Flash line.

Where the model actually improved

Google’s own benchmark numbers concentrate the gains in three areas: software engineering, web development, and document-heavy work.

The rest of the spec sheet carries over what Flash users expect: a 1M-token context window, up to 64K output tokens, and support for text, image, audio, and video input. Developers can also tune how much the model thinks before answering, trading quality against cost and speed.

Pricing starts at half rate, but not forever

Through December 31, 2026, Gemini 3.7 Flash costs $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens via the API. That is half of what 3.6 Flash launched at. From January 1, 2027, the price doubles to $1.50 and $7.50.

If you are building on the API, that deadline matters more than the launch itself. Anything you ship on the introductory rate will cost twice as much to run in the new year.

Where you can use it

For regular Gemini users, the model shows up first in Gemini Spark, the background agent inside the Gemini app, for AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in over 160 countries. Google has not said whether 3.7 Flash becomes the default model for normal Gemini app chats.

Developers get it today in Google AI Studio, Android Studio, and Google Antigravity, and businesses through the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and the Gemini Enterprise app.

The flagship is still missing

The Flash line is moving fast, but Google’s top model is not. Bloomberg reports that Gemini 3.5 Pro remains delayed, with no release date from Google. Back at I/O 2026, Google said 3.5 Pro would arrive within a month of the event. Nearly two months later, the smaller Flash models keep shipping while the flagship stays internal.

excerpt.rendered: Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after 3.6 Flash, with large coding benchmark jumps, Gemini Spark availability, and half-price API rates through 2026.

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to hide all signs of Snapchat Plus?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's possible to hide the badge and avoid using visible features, but some clues (like Snap replays) may still give it away.

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to hide all signs of Snapchat Plus?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's possible to hide the badge and avoid using visible features, but some clues (like Snap replays) may still give it away.

mainEntity.name: Which cosmetics do I get after purchasing Phantom Blade Zero on the Epic Games Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upon purchasing Phantom Blade Zero via the store, you will automatically unlock the Soul outfit, the Sanguine pickaxe, and the Sanguine back bling.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms will the Phantom Blade Zero cosmetics be available on?

acceptedAnswer.text: As long as you are using the same Epic Games Store account that you used to pre-order the game, you will be able to use the skin across all platforms where Fortnite is available.

mainEntity.name: Until when is the Phantom Blade Zero skin available with the game's purchase on the Epic Games Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Soul outfit can be claimed in Fortnite as a freebie with Phantom Blade Zero's purchase as long as the latter game is still available on the PC storefront. Hence, it can be interpreted as a permanent offer.

acceptedAnswer.text: The Soul outfit can be claimed in Fortnite as a freebie with Phantom Blade Zero's purchase as long as the latter game is still available on the PC storefront. Hence, it can be interpreted as a permanent offer.

mainEntity.name: Is it legal to download videos from X (Formerly Twitter)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can download videos for watching later or for other personal use. But reposting, especially for commercial use, may violate copyright laws. Always credit the original creator and seek permission before reuploading.

mainEntity.name: How to download a private Twitter video?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a private or protected X account, the only way is to screen record the video. Most third-party X video downloaders support only public posts. I wouldn't recommend trying to bypass the account's privacy controls.

title.rendered: WhatsApp is working on a custom emoji reaction tray for iPhone

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is building a way to change the six emoji that pop up when you long-press a message. WABetaInfo found a “Default reactions” setting in WhatsApp beta for iOS 26.32.10.16 on TestFlight, and it lets you swap any of the default reactions for an emoji of your choice.

The feature is still under development. It is not switched on for beta testers yet, and there is no release date.

How the custom tray would work

Today, every WhatsApp user sees the same reaction tray: thumbs up, red heart, tears of joy, surprised face, crying face, and folded hands. If you want anything else, you tap the plus button and hunt through the keyboard each time.

The new setting changes that at the source. According to the report, you can replace any of the six with any emoji from the keyboard, change as many of them as you like, and restore the original set from settings whenever you want. So if you keep reacting with the fire or skull emoji, they can sit in the tray instead of the folded hands you never touch.

It looks like a WhatsApp Plus perk

WABetaInfo says the custom tray is meant for WhatsApp Plus subscribers as part of the second batch of premium features. That comes from references in the beta, not from a WhatsApp announcement, so treat it as the likely plan rather than a confirmed one.

WhatsApp Plus is the optional subscription that rolled out on Android in April and reached iPhone in May, priced at $2.99 a month in the U.S. with different rates elsewhere. The first set of perks was all cosmetic: app themes, alternate icons, premium stickers, extra ringtones, and pinning up to 20 chats instead of three. A personal reaction tray fits that same pattern.

Messaging, calls, and end-to-end encryption stay free, and nothing about how reactions work for everyone else changes.

Android is on the same track

Android got there first. WABetaInfo spotted the same reaction tray in WhatsApp beta for Android 2.26.29.3 back in July, also under development and also tied to WhatsApp Plus. The iOS sighting suggests WhatsApp is lining both apps up before it turns the feature on.

It also lands in the same week WABetaInfo found animated chat themes for iOS in the beta, so WhatsApp is clearly leaning into customization on iPhone right now. If you are on the TestFlight beta, do not expect the setting to show up in this build. WhatsApp usually enables features like this in a later update once development wraps.

title.rendered: Tim Cook on his Apple legacy: “I hope that people say I was a good and decent man”

content.rendered:
Tim Cook has about two weeks left as Apple CEO, and he still won’t sum up his own legacy. Asked by CBS News’ Jo Ling Kent what he has stood for as head of the company, in a word, Cook skipped the word entirely.

“You’re asking a legacy question, and it’s a good question. But in my view, your legacy is described by others, not yourself,” he said. “And so I hope that people say I was a good and decent man. And if they say that at the end of the day, I feel like I have achieved something.”

The interview happened in Houston last week, where Cook was opening Apple’s new Advanced Manufacturing Center. CBS published the clip on August 13.

He had bigger numbers to point to

Cook could have answered with a business record. Apple’s own transition announcement in April put it plainly: since he took over from Steve Jobs in 2011, Apple’s market value has gone from around $350 billion to $4 trillion, and annual revenue has grown from $108 billion to more than $416 billion. Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple silicon, and the services business all arrived under him.

He chose character over any of that. It fits how Cook has handled the question before. He rarely tries to define his own legacy in public, and he did not start now, in one of his last sit-down interviews as CEO.

Two weeks until Ternus takes over

Apple confirmed in April that Cook is stepping down as CEO on September 1, 2026, and becoming executive chairman. Hardware chief John Ternus becomes CEO the same day and joins Apple’s board. As executive chairman, Cook is expected to keep handling parts of the job he is known for, including dealing with governments and policymakers.

The Houston trip shows what that looks like in practice. Cook opened the Advanced Manufacturing Center alongside Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick on August 13. Apple says it has put hundreds of millions of dollars into the Houston site in under nine months, has already shipped its first AI servers from the line there, and will start building Mac mini in the same facility later this year.

Cook already gave his last earnings call as CEO on July 30, telling analysts the handoff to Ternus was “going seamlessly.” After September 1, the iPhone launch, the AI push, and Apple’s post-Cook product roadmap all become Ternus’s story to tell. Cook, by his own framing, is leaving the verdict on his 15 years to everyone else.

title.rendered: ChatGPT can now open and edit your Google Drive files without leaving the chat

content.rendered:
OpenAI has started putting Google Drive inside ChatGPT’s Library. If you have the Google Drive plugin connected, your Drive files and folders now show up in Library, and you can pull a Doc, Sheet, or Slide into any conversation with an @mention instead of uploading it again. The file stays open beside the chat while ChatGPT summarizes, compares, or drafts from it, and where supported, ChatGPT can write changes back to the original file in Drive. OpenAI listed the change in its ChatGPT release notes on August 13 and posted a short demo on X the same day.

The usual flow was that ChatGPT read a Drive file and handed you a rewritten answer or a fresh document, and you still had to open Google Docs to make the change. This closes that loop. ChatGPT Consumer Product Lead Adam Fry confirmed on X that edits go live in the actual Drive file, and the original stays one click away, so you are not left juggling copies.

What you can do with it

The Library view includes everything in My Drive plus files and folders that were shared directly with you. From there, or straight from the composer, you can add a file to a chat and keep it open next to the conversation. You can also select an entire folder and ask ChatGPT to work across every file in it, which is handy for things like pulling numbers from a set of monthly Sheets or comparing several draft Docs.

Fry’s feature-drop recap points to the quickest route: tap the + button on the left of the prompt box, then choose Add from Library.

There are a few gaps at launch. Shared Drives are not included yet, and OpenAI says some Google Drive editing and collaboration features are still missing inside ChatGPT. Editing also only works where a file type supports it, and you have authorized ChatGPT to make changes, so this is not a full replacement for Docs or Sheets.

Who gets it and where

The rollout covers Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu, and Healthcare plans on the web, in both the regular Chat toggle and ChatGPT Work, OpenAI’s agent for longer multi-step tasks. Free and Go users are left out for now, and OpenAI only says mobile support “will follow” without a date. OpenAI’s X post named a shorter list of Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise, but the release notes are the fuller one.

If your Drive is not connected yet, you can add the Google Drive plugin from ChatGPT’s Plugin Directory first. Earlier Drive connections in ChatGPT, like the cloud drive access added to the Mac app, were built for searching files and answering questions about them. This update is about working on the file in front of you.

The Drive change landed on the same day as Computer History for the Mac app, and OpenAI followed it a day later with interactive quizzes for all consumer plans and personalized homepage suggestions for paid users. Taken together, the week reads like OpenAI trying to keep you inside ChatGPT for the whole task rather than just the first draft.

excerpt.rendered: OpenAI is rolling out Google Drive in ChatGPT’s Library for paid web users. You can @mention Drive files, work on them side by side, and let ChatGPT edit the original.

title.rendered: Star Wars Clone Wars and Mandalorian skins return to Fortnite: How to get them

content.rendered:
After roughly three months, Star Wars skins inspired by The Mandalorian live-action series and Star Wars: The Clone Wars animated series are back in Fortnite. The ongoing promotion in the Item Shop is the latest in a long-running series of Fortnite-Star Wars collaborative projects.

Among the Star Wars skins currently on sale are those modeled around Anakin Skywalker (Clone Wars), Ahsoka Tano (Clone Wars), and The Mandalorian (Pen & Ink)—all of which are priced at 1,500 V-Bucks. All these themed cosmetics are up for grabs until August 17 at 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET.

Steps to claim the Star Wars skins in Fortnite

  1. Launch Fortnite and go to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, scroll down to the Star Wars section and select the desired skin.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

Apart from going for skins individually, you also have the option of grabbing them with other cosmetics via The Mandalorian Bundle and The Clone Wars Bundle, priced at 2,000 V-Bucks and 2,700 V-Bucks, respectively. While the former bundle offers The Mandalorian skin with relevant items, The Clone Wars Bundle puts together the Anakin Skywalker skin and the Ahsoka Tano skin in a single package along with associated extras.

All Star Wars cosmetics in Fortnite

1. Beskar Mythosaur (back bling)

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Mandalorian Bundle

2. Beskar Spear (pickaxe)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Mandalorian Bundle

3. TIE Fighter Tow (emote)

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Mandalorian Bundle

4. Modified Beskar Halikset (pickaxe and back bling)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Mandalorian Bundle

5. BDX Droid

Price: 1,500 V-Bucks

6. Grogu

Price: 600 V-Bucks

7. Model Delta-7B Aethersprite

Price: 400 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Clone Wars Bundle

8. Mortis Dagger

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Clone Wars Bundle

9. Rotta the Huttlet

Price: 600 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Clone Wars Bundle

10. Improvised Battle Staff

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available with: The Clone Wars Bundle

11. Beskar

Price: 2,800 V-Bucks

Wrapping up

Thanks to Fortnite having a varied bunch of partnerships with other franchises, there is rarely a dearth of different cosmetics in the game’s deep catalog. Moreover, the fact that the Item Shop keeps rotating the various skins, back blings, pickaxes, and more on a regular basis ensures that something fresh is always there for the multiplayer game’s players to choose from.

In particular, certain long-term collaborators of Fortnite, such as Star Wars and Marvel, have been responsible for producing an array of memorable in-game additions. These have ranged from mere cosmetics to notable game modes, each of which has borne its corresponding franchise’s theme. Such a strong content library and tie-ups with major brands are among the big reasons why Fortnite has continued to remain popular in the mainstream even after 9 years since its launch.

In case you missed:

  • How to get MCU Iron Man and Captain America skins in Fortnite
  • How to unlock the Olivia Rodrigo skins in Fortnite
  • How to get Terminator skins in Fortnite
  • How to get Calm Capy sidekick in Fortnite

Update: Verified the latest A One Piece Game Codes on September 09, 2026

A One Piece Game makes you earn everything the hard way: levels, Devil Fruits, Haki, and enough Beli to keep up with it all. Codes are the shortcut. Boss Studios almost never retires them, so AOPG has one of the longest working code lists on Roblox. The newest ReAOPG batch alone hands you 200 million Beli, 12,000 Gems, and 25 Poneglyphs, and the older codes stack hours of 2x EXP, drop, and luck boosts on top. One catch: AOPG redeems codes through your YouTube Channel ID, so check the redeem steps below if the game keeps rejecting valid codes.

How to redeem AOPG codes

AOPG skips the usual code box. You have to link your YouTube Channel ID first, and that is the step most players miss:

  1. Subscribe to the developer’s YouTube channel.
  2. In YouTube, go to Settings > Advanced settings and copy your Channel ID.
  3. Open A One Piece Game on Roblox.
  4. Click Menu in the bottom-left corner.
  5. Click the blue bird icon.
  6. Paste your YouTube Channel ID when asked.
  7. Enter a working code and press Enter.

You only need to link the Channel ID once. After that, redeeming is just Menu, bird icon, code.

Why an AOPG code may not work

  • You skipped the YouTube step: Without a subscribed channel and a linked Channel ID, every code fails.
  • The code has expired: With a list this long, sites and Discord posts often lag behind removals.
  • A character is off: AOPG codes mix !, ?, ., underscores, and spaces. Copy and paste instead of typing.
  • You already redeemed it: Every code works once per Roblox account.
  • Your server is outdated: After an update, new codes only work on fresh servers, so rejoin.

Where to find more AOPG codes

Boss Studios drops new codes with updates, milestones, and compensation for bugs or delays. The fastest places to catch them:

  • AOPG Discord
  • Boss Studios on X
  • Theboss Brandon on YouTube
  • A One Piece Game on Roblox

The Discord announcements are the quickest, but with a code list this size, letting this page do the sorting saves you from testing dead strings one by one.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Blox Fruits codes, King Legacy codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: Fortnite Unstable live event: Start date, time, and what to expect

content.rendered:
It is a tradition for Epic Games to close out an ongoing Fortnite season with a bang. To that end, the devs organize a live event near the end of a season every time, after which the game transitions into the next one. The most recently announced live event, Fortnite Unstable, is scheduled to take place on August 15 at 2 PM ET, setting the stage for Chapter 7 Season 4.

On August 8, Fortnite first announced the forthcoming live event and added a timer for the same within the online game. Fast forward to August 13, the devs’ plans for the final week leading up to the next seasonal update coming with Fortnite Override were also revealed, incentivizing fans to partake in the action surrounding the season finale.

What is Fortnite Unstable?

Unstable is the next “story moment” in Fortnite that will act as the narrative bridge between the Runners season and the Override season. This event is also expected to herald changes to the Battle Royale map, which should fully come into effect once the new season rolls out next week on Thursday.

Epic Games’s official description for the event states that “something … or someone powerful is changing the game” and that “the future of the island hangs in the balance.” This strongly implies that we could see a cinematic sequence that reveals the actor behind the speculated impending changes coming to Chapter 7 Season 3’s Shattered Coast map.

At the same time when Fortnite Unstable begins, Mythic Hours are also scheduled to commence, making items such as Zero Point Sprite and Grim Sprite spawn more often. Importantly, the live event also acts as the starting point for a five-day stretch, called the Sprite Spree Week, which will allow players to make a final push for completing their Fortnite sprite collection before Chapter 7 Season 3 comes to a close.

Fortnite Unstable event date & time

The Unstable story moment will kick off in Fortnite on Saturday, August 15 at 11 AM PT or 2 PM ET. If you absolutely don’t want to miss out on this event, it is best to update your game beforehand and log in to Fortnite at least 5-10 minutes in advance to avoid any potential last-minute issues.

According to Egyptian Fortnite Leaker, a Fortnite informant on X with a growing follower base, Fortnite Unstable will show one character go through a speech that consists of 22 to 24 voice lines. The source also speculated that the live event could be a very short one, just lasting 2 to 3 minutes in total.

Final note

Live events tend to be a fairly memorable experience for Fortnite players. In the past, such events have also significantly changed the game before a major content drop, such as in the case of The End live event in December 2021.

While Fortnite Unstable is understandably not expected to be on the same massive scale as some of the past live events, it will still play a crucial role in tying up loose ends in the Fortnite lore. Notably, the Sprite Spree Week, which follows right after, will also be worth checking out next week, given it is tailored around those who are dedicated to indulging in this season’s Pokemon-esque sprite hunt.

FAQs

How early can I join Fortnite Unstable?

You can join a Fortnite Battle Royale match a few minutes before August 15, 2 PM ET, and watch the Unstable event unfold in real time within the same match.

Which was the last Fortnite live event?

The last live event was called Shattered, and it took place on June 5, 2026. It bridged the gap between Chapter 7 Season 2 and Season 3.

Which sprites will become more common during the Sprite Spree Week?

On their specific days, sprites of the galaxy, holofoil, cube, and gem variants will become more easily available during a match.

mainEntity.name: Which cosmetics do I get after purchasing Phantom Blade Zero on the Epic Games Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upon purchasing Phantom Blade Zero via the store, you will automatically unlock the Soul outfit, the Sanguine pickaxe, and the Sanguine back bling.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms will the Phantom Blade Zero cosmetics be available on?

acceptedAnswer.text: As long as you are using the same Epic Games Store account that you used to pre-order the game, you will be able to use the skin across all platforms where Fortnite is available.

mainEntity.name: Until when is the Phantom Blade Zero skin available with the game's purchase on the Epic Games Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Soul outfit can be claimed in Fortnite as a freebie with Phantom Blade Zero's purchase as long as the latter game is still available on the PC storefront. Hence, it can be interpreted as a permanent offer.

mainEntity.name: Is it legal to download videos from X (Formerly Twitter)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can download videos for watching later or for other personal use. But reposting, especially for commercial use, may violate copyright laws. Always credit the original creator and seek permission before reuploading.

mainEntity.name: How to download a private Twitter video?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a private or protected X account, the only way is to screen record the video. Most third-party X video downloaders support only public posts. I wouldn't recommend trying to bypass the account's privacy controls.

acceptedAnswer.text: You can join a Fortnite Battle Royale match a few minutes before August 15, 2 PM ET, and watch the Unstable event unfold in real time within the same match.

mainEntity.name: Which was the last Fortnite live event?

title.rendered: Bee Swarm Simulator codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Bee Swarm Simulator Codes on September 04, 2026

Bee Swarm Simulator has one of the slowest grinds on Roblox, and honey never piles up as fast as you want. The working codes below hand you free honey, tickets, event buffs, and even Marshmallow Bees without touching a single flower. Tickets are the real prize here, since they buy royal jelly and other premium items you would otherwise farm for hours. New codes are rare in this game, so redeem the current batch before Onett quietly retires it. The newest one, DiscordMillion, celebrates the game’s Discord hitting a million members.

All working Bee Swarm Simulator codes

  • DiscordMillion: 48-hour x2 Honeyday Event buff, 10 Mondo Chick Blessing, 2 Marshmallow Bee, and 1 Pink Balloon (NEW)
  • LatePresents: 2 Presents
  • ThreeBeeVee: 48 hours of x2 Pollen and Convert Rate, 1 Loaded Dice, and Mountain Top Field boost
  • 15MMembers: free reward
  • 38217: 5 Tickets
  • BeesBuzz123: Bitterberry x5 Cloud Vial x1 Gumdrops x5
  • BopMaster: 5 tickets
  • ClubBean: 1 Magic Bean, Pineapple Patch Boost x 2
  • Connoisseur: 5 tickets
  • Crawlers: 5 tickets
  • Nectar: 5,000 honey
  • Roof: 5 tickets
  • fourtunate: 1 Marshmallow Bee, 4 Strawberries, 4 Sunflower Seeds, 4 Blueberries, 4 Pineapples, 4 Micro-Converters, 4 Field Dice, 4 Gumdrops, 4 Jelly Beans, 4 Stingers
  • FrogFix: 1 Gingerbread Bear, 1 Marshmallow Bee, 5 Wealth Clocks, Mountain Top Field Boost, Mountain Top Field Capacity

Expired Bee Swarm Simulator codes

10MMEMBERS, 1MLIKES, 2MLIKES, 6IRTHDAY, BANNED, BEEQUIPTRADEREBOOT, BOO SWARM, BOXWHOOPS, BUZZ, CONNOISSEURS, DARZETHDOODADS, DEMIDECADE, OCTOBERSMAS, SONYXBOX, SUMMERSMAS, WAX, WEEKEXTENSION, WINK

How to redeem Bee Swarm Simulator codes

The code box is hidden inside the System menu, not in a separate shop.

  1. Open Bee Swarm Simulator on Roblox.
  2. Click the gear icon on the left side of the screen.
  3. Find the promo code box at the top of the System page.
  4. Paste a working code into the box.
  5. Hit Redeem to collect the reward.

Buffs like the Honeyday Event start ticking the moment you redeem, so save codes like DiscordMillion and ThreeBeeVee for a session when you can actually play.

Why a Bee Swarm Simulator code may not work

  • It expired: Onett removes codes without warning, and this game can go months without a new one.
  • You are not in the group: fourtunate and 15MMembers fail until you join the Bee Swarm Simulator Club.
  • You already used it: Each code works once per Roblox account.
  • There is a typo or stray space: Copy the code instead of retyping it, and trim spaces around it.
  • Your server is stale: Rejoin the game if a freshly released code refuses to go through.

If a code still fails in a fresh server, treat it as expired rather than hammering the Redeem button.

Where to find more Bee Swarm Simulator codes

New codes usually show up around big updates, community milestones, and holidays, and they land on the official channels first:

  • Bee Swarm Simulator Discord
  • Onett on X
  • Bee Swarm Simulator Club on Roblox

The Discord announcements channel is where codes drop first, but we keep this list updated and tested, so bookmarking this page saves you from digging through old messages.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Survive Zombie Arena codes, Ninja Time codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

In case you missed:

  • Giant Simulator Reborn codes
  • Legacy Piece codes
